checkpoint_verification.scope: Local returned receipts and prior audits only; checkpoint binary hashes/reload were verified on server.

figures.confusion_normalization: 100 * count / true-class support; true rows, predicted columns
figures.history_scope: 100 calibration + 96 fresh refit epochs, no smoothing or omissions

limitations: One seed42 independent implementation; no multiseed significance or unified-backbone/recipe superiority claim.
Class errors/confusions are descriptive associations and do not establish a module-specific mechanism.
Online train metrics aggregate changing weights; validation is epoch-end evaluation; refit has no validation.
All test paths/labels checked against the original manifest; no image or model loading, test replay or new training.
Current-attempt resources cover resumed attempt2 only. Whole-experiment wall/peak/cost are unavailable.
No paired correction/regression counts versus Swin/GAViT are inferred from aggregate totals.

recipe.disclosure: independent nonofficial implementation; paper confirms epochs/batch/Adam/lr/WD/CE and crop/flip only; precise augmentation, defaults, LR schedule, selection and preprocessing are explicit engineering choices

resource.accepted_history_scope: Completed accepted epochs only; refit75 wall field absent. Excludes discarded partial updates/setup and is not total experiment wall or billing.
resource.peak_scope: whole current engine invocation including diagnostics/checkpoint reload; resumed sessions separate
resource.test_evaluation_timing_scope: Recorded final test evaluation only; not a hardware-normalized inference benchmark.
resource.wall_scope: current attempt after stdlib preflight; setup, train, validation, IO, refit, test and end checks

scope: single-seed independent nonofficial complete-method diagnostics; offline record analysis
